reviews.reason: Interrogative 'which one?' and distal 'that one' are syntactic deployments of one deictic pronoun, not different referents lexicalized by the headword.
Identity, lineage, agency, authorship, and beneficiary questions all retain the ordinary interrogative 'who/whom'; the answer slot changes, not the pronoun's function.
Objects, people, places, and sayings supply different contextual answers to the same 'what is it?' question; no second lexical thing was found.
The prohibited act varies, but every witness is the same emphatic warning 'strictly avoid/beware'; its complement does not create another sense.
Sayings, doubts, jewels, and cases are different objects of the same public action of selecting and bringing forward.
Predicate completeness and attributive completeness in 具足戒 retain 'complete/fully endowed'; grammar alone does not split the sense.
Great capacity is a coordinated control, while every exact 大用 witness denotes great function or use; appraisals do not establish another referent.
Individual and assembly addressees, and differing preceding gestures, retain the same public question 'do you get it?'
The object proclaimed varies while the public act of raising and proclaiming remains stable across the stored witnesses.
Sensory sound-and-form, sensual entertainments, and voice-and-facial-expression are independently anchored different referents, not grammatical paraphrases.
